Sign in by approving a code in your browser; the CLI then acts as you. Works over SSH and in
containers: the code can be entered on any device.

The token is kept in the system keychain when there is one, for the configured API server only. In
CI and scripts, set VOIDHASH_API_KEY instead of signing in.

Usage:
  voidhash login [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help        Show help for this command
      --no-browser  Print the sign-in address and code without opening a browser
      --read-only   Sign in read-only: commands can look but not change anything

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash login
  voidhash login --read-only
  voidhash login --no-browser --profile staging
